context_for_ai: Aleksandra is Content Manager at Search Atlas / LinkGraph reporting to Justin Rondeau (Head of Growth). She manages the content team: Milena, Emanuel, Andresa, Mateus, James — plus collaborates with the broader marketing team. Team uses Claude Code MCP workflows and the SearchAtlas platform. Q2 2026: strategy focused on quality over volume, LPs as primary content type, improved intent targeting. Q2 goal: 360 weighted pts. Q2 final close: 400.69 pts (+11.3% above goal). Scoring model: 4k words = 1pt, LP = 3pt, case study = 3pt, everything else = 1pt. Q3 2026 targets: 420 weighted pts total (~33/wk), 5 SA articles/week, recover LLM visibility to 30% across 3+ platforms, recover organic traffic to 16,900 clicks/28d. Current state (June 2026): LLM visibility collapsed from 50.8% to 10% — only ChatGPT (40%) and Copilot (20%) show any; Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode all at 0%. Organic clicks down 18.3% despite position improving 33.4 → 28.2 (CTR gap, likely AI Mode click displacement). 19 pages in 3-period content decay. Top quick win: 'google ai mode' at 39K impressions / position 6.2. AI CMO batch (6 articles) in production June 2026. ContentGenius quality lags Claude Code MCP output — feedback to Jason is a live Q3 priority.
